limitations: The source test suites are externally generated evaluation data, not LeetCode authoritative hidden tests.
DACDM may register a source suite only when at least 20 distinct deterministic input/output cases can be parsed from the frozen row.
S1.3.9 stores provenance and hashes rather than redistributing the external test payloads.
A numerically sufficient source suite does not by itself prove IF-09 ordinary/edge-case coverage; that remains a separate pre-inference gate.
No model performance results are inspected and no paid model API calls are made in S1.3.9.
